title: Jesus bids us shine
lyrics: [G]Jesus bids us shine with a cl[D7]ear, pure light,
[D7]Like a little ca[G]ndle burning in the night;
[G]In this world of darkness,[C] we must s[G]hine,
[G]You in your small corner [C]and[D7] I in[G] mine.
Jesus bids us shine, then, for all around
Many kinds of darkness in this world abound
Sin and want and sorrow; we must shine,
You in your small corner, and I in mine.
